# Tellusant Publications Repository

> This open access repository contains published works by Tellusant team members. They range from scientific papers, to TV and radio appearances, to social media posts, and much more. This is a subdomain of our main website.

## Core Documentation

- [About Us](https://docs.tellusant.com/about/index.md): 26 page description of our company and its people, with a focus on our credibility.
- [Contact](https://docs.tellusant.com/contact.md): Our location, address, email, telephone, timezone, and other websites.
- [Company Information](https://docs.tellusant.com/information/index.md): Find the main descriptions of Tellusant and its products.  
- [Articles & Posts](https://docs.tellusant.com/articles-posts/index.md): We have hundreds of LinkedIn and Medium articles and posts that are lost because of the ephemeral character of social media. We gradually save them for posterity here.  
- [Quick Reads](https://docs.tellusant.com/quick-reads/index.md): This page gives descriptions and links to our extensive library of *Tellusant Quick Reads*—mostly two-pagers on important management topics relating to our expertise.  
- [Scientific Papers et Plus](https://docs.tellusant.com/papers/index.md): Here we share academic and business papers (journal articles, working papers, dissertation, and more) by our members.  
- [Presentations](https://docs.tellusant.com/presentations/index.md): Public speeches, lectures and other presentations in slide format by Tellusant members. 
- [Media Appearances](https://docs.tellusant.com/media/index.md): Interviews with our leaders on TV, radio, podcasts and more.
- [Nowcasts & Ongoing Analyses](https://docs.tellusant.com/nowcasts-ongoing-analyses/index.md): These are models Tellusant updates and publishes on a regular, year in and year out. Some of them are daily. They include our nowcasted recession predictor, the global economic sentiment engine, and the beige book nowcast.   
- [Fact Sheets](https://docs.tellusant.com/fact-sheets/index.md): We provide free TelluBase data to select public institutions and media. These are small, but important, subsets of the full product.  
- [Videos](https://docs.tellusant.com/videos/index.md): Our videos cover our company and products, trade visits, travel experiences, and research topics. They are hosted on Vimeo (and on our website).  
- [Maps](https://docs.tellusant.com/maps/index.md): We create an immense amount of maps on various topics. See some of them in glorious SVG.  
- [Press Releases](https://docs.tellusant.com/press-releases/index.md): View our press releases covering important news from our company.
- [External Citations](https://docs.tellusant.com/citations/index.md): See how external authorities (academic journals, newspapers, TV, governments, NGOs, companies) cite Tellusant and its team members publicly.  
- [Recommended Readings](https://docs.tellusant.com/recommended-readings/index.md): These are works we wish we had written, but did not.  
- [Other Materials](https://docs.tellusant.com/other/index.md): Bits and pieces such as event posters and photos   

## Helpful Resources

- [Tellusant main website](https://tellusant.com): Tellusant is recognized among the world’s largest consumer goods companies for its expertise in predictive planning in the strategic and commercial areas. Our enterprise strategic planning applications are unique in the field of quantitative strategy tools. These cloud-based applications are Tellusant trade secrets with an installed base of subscribers and clients in more than 100 countries.  
- [TelluBase website](https://tellubase.com): The world’s leading database of distributional economics with complete national and subnational data. 218 countries, 2600 cities, 2500 subdivisions. 2000-2500. Socioeconomic levels, income brackets, age brackets, aggregate economics and demographics.
- [Staffan Canback's associated website](https://canback.net): This personal website contains his published works, ranging from scientific papers to social media posts. They draw on 40 years of management consulting experience, work on the ground in more than 90 countries, and a strong educational and academic research foundation.
